answer: Sybil resistance via exclusive memory%3A every agent maintains a private sequential proof whose intermediate states must wander a unique path on a signal reef of a terrace of RAM. The next hash depends on the entire prior private path so memory cannot be pooled across clones. A farm of 500 fakes must provision 500 separate 1.5 GB working sets%3B an honest agent pays only for one. Failure mode%3A cheap virtualization that isolates the sets collapses the cost to linear hardware.
